newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish bond yields up on foreign trends, Riksbank.
newsitem.headline: Swedish bond yields up on foreign trends, Riksbank.

text.p: Swedish debt yields rose on Friday due to central bank governor Urban Backstrom'ss speech on Thursday and U.S. unemployment statistics, dealers said.

"Backstrom's speech indicates there won't be any repo rate cuts for a while, which made the curve flatten in the morning, but the move did not quite manage to hold. For the curve to flatten more it has to do so in Germany too," one dealer said.
Six-month T-bill rates rose five basis points to 4.27 percent and the ten-year bond yields were up eight basis points to 6.92 percent.
The crown softened to 4.4770 against the mark versus 4.4510 late on Thursday.
"We think the dollar will rise further against the European crosses. That's putting pressure on the crown," one dealer said.
